component.name: ReDrawable
component.summary: Use a reMarkable tablet as a pressure-sensitive pen tablet

description.p: Plug a reMarkable Paper Pro (reMarkable 2 and 1 in beta) into your PC and draw in Krita, GIMP, Inkscape or any app with tablet support: pressure, tilt, hover and the eraser end. Independent project, not made or endorsed by reMarkable AS.
